items.title: 4.2 Python mein databases ke saath kaam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.2 (PDF 56, printed 52), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Python mein databases ke saath kaam ka matlab hai database systems mein data rakhna aur sambhalna. Python programs databases se jur kar data dal (insert), nikal (retrieve), badal (update) aur mita (delete) sakte hain. Databases applications ko bohat zyada maloomat achhi tarah sambhalne dete hain aur data ko durust aur yaksan (consistent) rakhte hain. Python built-in aur bahar ki (external) libraries ke zariye database ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Databases programs ko bohat si maloomat mehfooz tareeqe se rakhne aur zaroorat par jaldi nikalne dete hain.

items: Python databases mein data dal, nikal, badal aur mita sakta hai.
Databases bohat sa data mehfooz, durust aur yaksan rakhte hain.
